result:
Both test classes compiled successfully.

I created two self-contained JUnit 5 test classes based on the javadoc contracts:

- `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/AnnotationUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `equals` (null handling, identity, matching/differing members, cross-type comparison), `hashCode` (documented formula, equals/hashCode consistency, and the documented `RuntimeException`/`IllegalStateException` failure modes via dynamic proxies), `isValidAnnotationMemberType` (valid primitive/String/Class/Annotation/Enum/single-dim array types vs. boxed types, multi-dim arrays, arbitrary types, and `null`), and `toString` (non-null, documented member formatting).
- `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/AbstractReflectionAgentTest.java` — covers `getForceAccessible` (system property parsing including unset/true/false/unparsable), `isForceAccessible`/builder defaults, `setAccessible(boolean, AccessibleObject)` and the package-private instance `setAccessible(Field)` (null handling, forcing vs. not forcing, already-accessible short-circuit), and the undocumented package-private `toRegisterPair`/`register`/`isRegistered`/`unregister` round-trip implied by their names and signatures.

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`. No other files were modified.
